data.text:
Another day, another desperate hallucination from the infamous Red-Tagging Queen of the Philippine Islands, Lorraine Badoy! 

Super impressive for this  UNHINGED red tagger to spend so much time "investigating" people na sure na sure syang mga NPA operatives at assets “daw”. 

But she can’t even spend five minutes to check the Philippine Constitution.

Since logic seems to be your kryptonite, why don’t we break down why your "scoop" is literally garbage, shall we? 

FIRST AND FOREMOST (and the most basic of all): 

Article VII, Section 19 of the Philippine Cosntitution is written in plain English: 

“xxx the President may grant reprieves, commutations, and pardons, and remit fines and forfeitures, after conviction by final judgment.”

Ghorl, is Ramil Madriaga already a convicted felon? 

Hindi! 

May final judgment na ba ang kaso nya? 

Wala! 

His case is currently pending at the Manila RTC Branch 21!  

So, how can PBBM pardon someone for a crime they haven’t been convicted of yet? 

You claim PBBM has a “pardon deal” with Madriaga? 

Ghorl, that’s legally impossible and intellectually embassing for you to even believe that! 

Super basic logic, hindi mo ma-follow. 

SECOND, your "BJMP Asset" is a moron! 

Why don’t you fire him/her immediately? 

BJMP is only for detainees awaiting trial or those with petty sentences. 

BuCor (Bilibid), on the other hand, is for convicted felons.

If Madriaga were actually in a position to be "pardoned," he would NOT be in a BJMP facility; he would be in Bilibid! 

The fact that he’s still under BJMP custody is proof that no conviction exists! 

THIRD, do you honestly think a Presidential Pardon can be done in secret? 

A pardon requires public notice and a formal process through the Board of Pardons and Parole. 

Yes, ghorl, the BPP has the jurisdiction, not BJMP! 

To suggest the President would leave a "receipt" for a bribe just to get a statement from a BJMP detainee is a level of stupidity that only a DDS influencer could achieve.👏😂

FOURTH, you spent YEARS red-tagging everyone with a pulse. 

You even red-tagged me on national TV nga bigaon ka! 

Yet, you don’t even understand how a basic government process works. 

Meaning you were also so careless about the way you red-tagged people! 

Is being "shunga" a main requirement for you now? 

Your "asset" is a moron, your "logic" is a joke, and your understanding of the law is non-existent! 

Next time, magbasa ka muna ng basics, like kung ano ang sinasabi sa Constitution bago ka magpalaganap ng fake news mo!

——

P.S. Proud na proud pa si Krizette mag share. Girl, akala ko bright ka? 😂
